info.name: HEIC/HEIF Image Converter
info.summary: Converts your images to different formats
info.description:
# HEIC/HEIF Image Converter
Convert images to other formats with the power of ImageMagick and the PHP Imagick extension.
## ✨ Features
- **📦 Flexible conversion**: Convert your photos and images to common formats such as JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, JXL, and HEIC. - **⚙️ ImageMagick-based**: Uses the installed ImageMagick engine and PHP Imagick bindings for reliable processing. - **🧩 Compatibility-aware**: Supported formats depend on the version and features of your ImageMagick installation.
## Notes > Requires ImageMagick with support for your desired formats and the PHP Imagick extension enabled. Check the GitHub project for setup details and compatibility notes.
